items.Sentence: The headworks includes a magnetic-type flow meter, a mechanically cleaned screen, a bypass channel with a bar screen, an influent sampler, and two cutthroat flumes

Secondary treatment consists of two aeration basins providing a complete mix activated sludge process using extended retention of biological solids... The repeated cycling of environments nitrifies and denitrifies the wastewater... With the separate zones, the aeration system can achieve biological nitrogen removal.
Two 50-feet diameter, 16-feet side-water-depth secondary clarifiers remove the biomass... The clarifiers include a second center well, the flocculation well
Solids handling consists of pumping WAS from the secondary clarifiers to a biosolids storage basin... The basin is scheduled to be dredged, dewatered
Secondary effluent can either flow by gravity or be pumped to the chlorine contact basins where chlorine solution is used to achieve disinfection and sulfur dioxide solution is used to dechlorinate.
During dry weather, effluent is recycled for dry-weather maintenance of the Hiller storm water treatment wetland... or irrigation of agricultural lands.
